offering_description.value: Manufactures engineered wood products and plywood, and distributes lumber and building materials to lumber yards, home centers, builders and industrial customers. Sells through its own manufacturing plants and distribution branches.

primary_products.value: plywood; engineered wood products; lumber; particleboard; specialty building materials

primary_services.value: delivery and inventory management; supply chain support for builders

customer_segment.value: B2B: lumber yards, home centers, builders, roofing and industrial customers

end_markets.value: residential construction; repair and remodel; commercial construction; industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: wood products and building materials sold to dealers, builders and industrial customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes plywood, engineered wood and particleboard from timber and wood fiber, sold to distributors and builders; distributor: buys lumber and building materials from producers and sells to lumber yards, contractors and industrial buyers

geography_served.value: North America: United States with a limited Canadian presence

specialization.value: related lines: wood products manufacturing and building materials distribution, sharing construction customers and supply chain

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to builders, dealers and industrial accounts; own locations: company-operated distribution branches and manufacturing plants

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, forestry, worker safety and transport rules, overseen by EPA and state agencies

notes: Canadian footprint is limited, so geography reflects mainly US operations.
